title: The cron job is the game engine
dek: A guide to building daily games and self-updating sites with nothing but GitHub Actions, a JSON file, and an idempotent script. The whole genre is three moving parts.

title: Cloudflare vs AWS: the decision matrix
dek: Why Prompterjack shifted to Workers, where AWS is still the right answer, and the evaluation framework that matters more than either logo.

title: Running a fleet of Claude agents without them trampling each other
dek: Git worktrees as the isolation primitive, one agent per checkout, containerised previews routed by hostname — the concurrency model behind Claude Work Manager and Worktree Optimiser.

title: Every number defends itself
dek: Correctness engineering in QuantFlex: anchor tests, triple-verified Greeks, and a static import gate that keeps the 'hand-rolled' claim honest.

title: Letting an agent act while you sleep
dek: ALFRED runs on my hardware and acts on its own schedule. The tool-safety envelope — allowlists, capability tiers, audit trails — is what makes that survivable.
